name: Sophie Manente
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Sophie welcomes her clients into a space that feels safe, warm and non-judgemental. Sophie works with adults and young people experiencing depression, anxiety, PTSD/C-PTSD, bipolar disorder, borderline personality disorder, and various other conditions. She has extensive experience working with survivors of complex trauma, such as sexual assault and family violence. She integrates a range of treatment modalities into her work and always uses a trauma-informed and anti-oppressive lens. *Sophie is currently offering online sessions.*
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Hiro McLeman
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: My name is Hiro (they/them) I am a Counsellor located in Naarm / Melbourne, Australia. I am a queer, non-binary, neurodivergent, mixed Japanese and white person. My lived experience being queer, trans, neurodivergent and POC informs my work, seeing me embrace an anti-oppressive, de-colonising, intersectional feminist and queer lens. I enjoy working with the LGBTIQA+ community, people questioning their sexuality and or gender identity and allies. I have several years professional experience working as a Counsellor at a community health organisation that specialises in working with the LGBTIQ+ community and people living with and affected by HIV.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Trudy Clutterbok
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I've worked as a senior clinician, supervisor, counsellor, mental health social worker and psychoanalyst in public and private settings with children and adults for many years. I provide clinical supervision to counsellors, mediators, social workers and reflective practice sessions to others in the health and allied health fields (Psychiatry, Nursing, General Practice, Midwifery, Emergency Services). I especially enjoy my work with those in the Arts and the LGBTQ+ / GBKS communities and with those who feel like outsiders.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Laura Wheelwright
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Laura is a strengths-based counsellor, who specialises in attachment and interpersonal relationships. Laura has many years’ experience supporting individuals to understand their relational patterns, navigating mental ill health in relationships, how they shape our identity and self-esteem, and how to build confidence in relationships and set boundaries. Laura also has a creative background and emphasises the healing power of creativity and self-expression in therapy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Gillian Fernandes
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
address: Northside Therapy Collective, Level 1 680 High St
description: Gillian has a Masters Degree in Counselling specialising in couples and relationships. Gillian supports folks to de-escalate their relationship conflict, gain insight into what is keeping them stuck in their problematic patterns, use strategies to avoid escalating relationship distress, enhance deep connection, and increase sexual intimacy. Gillian began her career at Relationships Australia where she worked with people facing infidelity, parenting concerns, emotional distance, communication difficulties, sex and intimacy issues, identity and sexuality questions, separation, and forming new relationships.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy
